page.overview:
What is Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Hound?

The Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Hound is a Zoan-type Devil Fruit that allows its user to transform into a hound hybrid and a full hound at will. It was eaten by Hound.

This fruit enables the eater to become a hound at will, granting an increase in physical strength, speed, and senses. Being a predatory canine, Hound is better suited for physical combat than herbivorous Zoans.

Aside from the standard Devil Fruit weakness, this fruit does not seem to have any specific weaknesses.
